desc: The Gas Crack from Agency Arms redefines the standard for charging handles with its groundbreaking design and functionality. Engineered for rapid and effortless use, it ensures smooth operation from either side of your firearm. Featuring a high shelf and gas crack design, this charging handle effectively reduces gas blowback towards the shooter's face, enhancing comfort and focus during operation. Crafted in the USA from high-grade 7075 aluminum and finished with MILSPEC anodizing, it combines exceptional durability with a sleek, ergonomic design. Experience the perfect blend of innovation and performance with the Gas Crack Charging Handle.
